_comment: One remediation, twenty-eight days, seven deliveries. Business dates are weeks apart and are what every figure is computed from; wall-clock is compressed when this is replayed. Every event falls on a business day. Nothing here is a transition -- each event names a destination and the lifecycle decides whether the case may go there.
